papers.title: Correlation between process parameters, microstructure and properties of 316 L stainless steel processed by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Centre for Advanced Manufacturing Technologies / Fraunhofer Project Center, Wrocław University of Science and Technology, ul. Łukasiewicza, 50-371 Wrocław, Poland

corresponding_authors.name: Tomasz Kurzynowski
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Advanced Manufacturing Technologies / Fraunhofer Project Center, Wrocław University of Science and Technology, ul. Łukasiewicza, 50-371 Wrocław, Poland

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化316L不锈钢的工艺参数-微观组织-性能关系，虽未直接涉及生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽或多孔结构，但为医用金属增材制造提供了基础工艺与力学性能参考。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not focus on porous structures for stress shielding, fatigue behavior, surface roughness for osseointegration, or any specific biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立SLM 316L不锈钢工艺-微观组织-性能关联
summary_zh.method: 通过工艺参数调控，表征微观组织与力学性能
summary_zh.result: 发现工艺参数对致密度、硬度、强度有显著影响
summary_zh.validation: 采用拉伸与硬度实验验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To establish a comprehensive correlation between process parameters, microstructure, and mechanical properties of 316L stainless steel fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Systematic experimental characterization of density, microstructure, and mechanical properties under varying laser power and scanning speed.
summary_en.result: Process parameters significantly affect densification behavior, phase composition, and resulting hardness and tensile strength.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile and hardness) was performed to validate the property variations.

papers.title: A comparison of Selective Laser Melting with bulk rapid solidification of AlSi10Mg alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Chemistry, Università di Torino, Torino, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: L. Battezzati
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Chemistry, Università di Torino, Torino, Italy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是AlSi10Mg合金的选择性激光熔化与快速凝固，与生物医学植入物无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on AlSi10Mg alloy for non-biomedical applications, with no porous structures, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing for implants, or surface roughness/osseeintegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较选区激光熔化与快速凝固对AlSi10Mg合金组织的影响。
summary_zh.method: 利用SLM和铜模吸铸制备样品进行微观结构对比。
summary_zh.result: SLM样品具有更细的微观组织和更高的硬度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM和硬度测试验证组织差异。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the microstructural evolution of AlSi10Mg alloy processed by selective laser melting and bulk rapid solidification.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM and copper mold suction casting, followed by microstructural characterization.
summary_en.result: SLM produced finer cellular structures and higher hardness compared to bulk rapid solidification.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural differences were validated using scanning electron microscopy and hardness measurements.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Juntendo University Urayasu Hospital, 2-1-1 Tomioka, Urayasu City, Chiba, 279-0021, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床随访研究，不涉及股骨近端应力或微动分析，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no implant stress/strain analysis, no micromotion or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 监测金属对金属全髋关节置换术后血清铬水平变化。
summary_zh.method: 对患者进行12年血清铬水平跟踪检测。
summary_zh.result: 血清铬水平随时间变化情况。

summary_en.motivation: To monitor serum chromium level changes after metal-on-metal total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Serum chromium levels were tracked in patients over 12 years.
